P35828.name: S-layer protein (Paracrystalline surface layer protein)
P35828.function: The S-layer is a paracrystalline mono-layered assembly of proteins which coats the surface of bacteria. Probably acts as a physical barrier to parasites and lytic enzymes.

P55131.function: Does not have hemolytic activity but shows a strong cytotoxicity towards alveolar macrophages and neutrophils.
